risks.risk: Model mismatch: the unit may not be the SX-600 (model number not readable in photos).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the model label/plate (usually rear panel or underside) showing 'SX-600'.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic Yamaha keyboard of unknown exact model/age (worst-case for value).

risks.risk: Not truly working: keys, speakers, power supply, or buttons may have faults not visible in photos.
risks.proof: Short video: power on + screen/LEDs + play a few notes + demonstrate at least one sound/keyboard function and volume through the built-in speaker.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed working (worst-case: needs servicing).

risks.risk: Speaker/amp issues: grille is visible but sound quality/volume level is unknown.
risks.proof: Video clip showing volume knob changes and audible output (or a line-out test if available).

risks.risk: Missing accessories/cables (power adapter, sustain pedal, stand) affecting buyer cost.
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out (power cable/adapter, sustain pedal, manuals/stand if any).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming only the keyboard is included (no extras).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the model label/plate showing 'SX-600'.
Power-on video showing the display/LEDs and that keys produce sound through the speaker.
Video showing volume control and at least one function change (sound/keyboard mode).
Photo of included items (power adapter/cable, sustain pedal, any stand/manual).
response.reason: The photos confirm it is a Yamaha keyboard, but the exact 'SX-600' model and the '100% working' claim are not verifiable from the images alone. Request model-label proof and a power-on/playing video before pricing confidently.
